time_plan.30m: Check whether a specific news catalyst (investigation, scandal, defection) drove the probability move versus noise/thin liquidity.
time_plan.1h: Compare SPY futures move to baseline intraday range; confirm whether reaction is present at all.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether the move correlates with any policy-relevant headline (tariffs, appointments) rather than pure impeachment odds.
time_plan.6h: Re-check if move persists into the next session or fully mean-reverts, indicating noise.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in implied probability of a House impeachment vote signals elevated US political instability. However, House impeachment alone (no Senate conviction or removal) is a weak market catalyst: both 2019 and 2021 Trump impeachments produced negligible equity reaction. Any risk-off would likely be small and short-lived, far below the 700bp tradable threshold.

predictions.reasoning: Rising political-uncertainty odds can lift demand for hedges, modestly bidding implied volatility. But impeachment of a sitting president with a divided Congress rarely moves realized volatility meaningfully, and the House-only resolution criterion is largely symbolic. Any vol bump is likely small and mean-reverting, well under the tradable threshold.

evidence_used: Market resolves on House-only impeachment vote, explicitly excluding Senate conviction and removal
Historical precedent: 2019 and 2021 Trump impeachments produced minimal S&P 500 reaction
Event probability is heavily conditioned on 2026 midterm House composition (Democratic majority needed)
Prediction window is only 12h, limiting scope for large asset repricing
uncertainty_notes: Impeachment odds are driven by domestic political dynamics that historically decouple from asset prices
A probability spike could reflect thin prediction-market liquidity rather than genuine information
If a move were tied to a broader scandal affecting policy continuity (tariffs, Fed, fiscal), equity impact could be larger — but that is a different catalyst

llm_justification.summary: This market maps weakly to public assets. A House-only impeachment vote is largely symbolic and, per 2019/2021 precedent, moves markets little. A sharp odds shift would at most produce a modest risk-off in broad US equities and a small volatility bid, both far below the 700bp tradable threshold. The honest read is low-confidence and not tradable within a 12h window.
key_assumptions: Market participants price House impeachment as symbolic absent Senate removal
No accompanying policy-disruption catalyst travels with the impeachment odds move
Prediction-market probability move reflects real information, not liquidity noise
failure_modes: The impeachment odds move is already public/priced, so no incremental asset reaction
The move is prediction-market noise from thin liquidity with zero equity linkage
The true driver is a broader scandal affecting policy, making SPY/VIX poor isolated proxies
Direction could reverse quickly as markets recognize the House-only, non-removal resolution has minimal practical consequence
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
